JOURNAL

Late-night notes: how this site started

2026.09.16

Before the first song officially comes out, there's already a lot of material sitting around — in notebooks, in phone memos, in folders in a recording studio: fragments of melody, lyrics not yet settled, moments captured mid-rehearsal. In a way, this site is a place to settle the name "Yu Stellar" first, so the work still in progress has a coordinate where it can be found.

Over time this will slowly turn into a record: how a song started from a single line, the nerves and preparation before a live show, the instinctive reaction to hearing a certain arrangement. Compared to a formal press release, these notes are closer to leaving the studio's own murmured thoughts exactly as they were.

If you happen to be passing through and there isn't much here yet — that's alright, take your time. Stars need a little time before they're seen, too.
